svg.aria-label: Bar chart of four different numbers reported for the same summary sentence of the North Third Chain: 12,440 li counted with water-course mileage, 12,350 li as the source text spells it, 10,540 li counted without water-course mileage, and 2,350 li as recorded by the pipeline numeral parser. The top two differ by 90 li, or 0.7 percent.
svg.title: Four Numbers for One Sentence: The North Third Chain
svg.desc: Horizontal bar chart of four values reported for the same line of the Shanhaijing, the summary sentence of the North Third Chain. 12,440 li is the sum of the 47 entries with water-course mileage included. 12,350 li is what the source text literally says. 10,540 li is the sum with water-course mileage excluded. 2,350 li is the figure the structure layer numeral parser produced from the same string, by dropping a leading ten-thousand character. The first two differ by 90 li, or 0.7 percent; the bottom value is an artefact of parsing, not of the manuscript. Source: Shanhaijing chain summaries, route reconciliation and record units, findns.cc/shanhaijing, retrieved 2026-10-21.
svg.text: The summary sentence of the North Third Chain (003-3.47), as reported by four pipeline layers
Counted: the 47 entries summed, water-course mileage included
Declared: the source text literally reads 萬二千三百五十里
Counted: water-course segments excluded from the stop list
Declared: as recorded by the structure layer’s numeral parser
the residue once the character is restored
the headline gap, against the counted total
Source: Shanhaijing chain summaries (SKILL_02a), route reconciliation (SKILL_03n), record units (SKILL_04g), findns.cc/shanhaijing, retrieved 2026-10-21.
